suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 | component: kotlin-gradle-plugin build cache (deserialization) | NOT_APPLICABLE (false positive). Evidence: OWASP matches the generic CPE "jetbrains:kotlin" against org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-stdlib* runtime jars (transitive, e.g. via OkHttp in the Brevo client). Those jars do not contain the Gradle build-cache code, and this project builds with Maven, not Gradle. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: if a kotlin-gradle-plugin / kotlin-compiler artifact ever appears in this module's dependency tree.

CVE-2026-59313 (LOW, AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:R) | component: Spring MVC functional web framework SSE (RouterFunction / ServerResponse.sse()) - CRLF stream corruption | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: grep of src/main for RouterFunction|ServerResponse|SseEmitter|text/event-stream returns nothing; all endpoints are annotated @RestController methods returning JSON. Advisory also requires plain-text (non-JSON) SSE payloads. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: any SSE/streaming endpoint or functional routing is introduced.

CVE-2026-47890 (LOW) | component: Spring MVC/WebFlux SSE with view fragments (FragmentsRendering) | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no view technology on the classpath (no thymeleaf/freemarker/mustache/jsp in pom.xml), no SSE (grep for SseEmitter|text/event-stream|FragmentsRendering in src/main: none). API returns JSON only. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: a template engine or SSE endpoint is added.

CVE-2026-47891 (MEDIUM, A:L) | component: spring-webflux Jaxb2Decoder maxInMemorySize bypass with Aalto XML | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no spring-webflux and no aalto-xml in dependency tree (mvnw dependency:tree, 2026-10-09). The jaxb-runtime present is Hibernate's transitive dependency and is not wired to any WebFlux codec. API accepts JSON only. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: spring-webflux or aalto-xml added, or XML request bodies accepted.

CVE-2026-47892 (MEDIUM, CWE-863) | component: WebFlux functional endpoints header-predicate bypass on CORS pre-flight | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no spring-webflux on classpath; grep for RouterFunction / RequestPredicates in src/main returns nothing. Authorization is enforced by Spring Security filter chain (shared/config/SecurityConfig.java), not routing predicates. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: spring-webflux or functional endpoints (RouterFunction) introduced.

CVE-2026-59283 (MEDIUM, A:H) | component: spring-expression SpEL compiler bypassing SimpleEvaluationContext guards | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: grep for SpelExpressionParser|SimpleEvaluationContext|spring.expression.compiler.mode in src/main and application*.properties returns nothing; no @PreAuthorize/@PostAuthorize in src/main. spring-expression is present only transitively (spring-security-web). Both preconditions (SimpleEvaluationContext AND compiler mode IMMEDIATE/MIXED) unmet. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: any SpEL evaluation of user input, or spring.expression.compiler.mode is set (also as JVM -D flag).

CVE-2026-47893 (LOW, CWE-209) | component: spring-webflux HandshakeWebSocketService (headers in exception reason) | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no spring-webflux and no spring-websocket in dependency tree; grep WebSocket in src/main returns nothing. (tomcat-embed-websocket is present transitively via spring-boot-starter-tomcat but is not Spring's handshake service.) Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: WebSocket/STOMP or WebFlux support added.

CVE-2026-59282 (MEDIUM, A:H) | component: spring-beans data binding (DataBinder/BeanWrapper) unbounded growth of a self-populating List on nested indexed paths | MITIGATED. Evidence: Spring MVC DataBinder IS active (implicit @ModelAttribute/@RequestParam binding of query/form params), but the advisory additionally requires a bind target with a self-populating List (get() allocates on demand) whose element type has sub-properties. grep src/main for AutoPopulatingList|LazyList|ListUtils|"implements List"|"extends AbstractList"| "extends ArrayList"|setAutoGrow|@InitBinder|WebDataBinder returns nothing; request DTOs are Jackson @RequestBody records (not DataBinder) with plain java.util.List fields, which throw IndexOutOfBoundsException (safe per advisory). Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: any custom/auto-populating List type on a request/form-bound object, or @InitBinder changes.

CVE-2026-59281 (MEDIUM, XSS) | component: spring-context EscapedErrors (HTML-escaped data-binding Errors rendered in views) | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no server-side HTML rendering (no template engine in pom.xml); grep EscapedErrors in src/main returns nothing. The only getFieldErrors() use is GlobalExceptionHandler.java:95 on a raw BindingResult (not EscapedErrors), serialized into a JSON ErrorResponse (application/json), not HTML. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: any HTML view/template rendering or EscapedErrors / RequestContext.getErrors(..., true) usage.

CVE-2026-59280 (MEDIUM, CWE-22) | component: spring-context-support FreeMarker SpringTemplateLoader path traversal via backslash in view name | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no freemarker dependency in pom.xml/dependency tree; grep freemarker|SpringTemplateLoader|ModelAndView in src/main returns nothing; controllers return ResponseEntity/JSON, never untrusted view names. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: FreeMarker (or any view resolver) added, or a controller returns a String view name.

CVE-2026-59314 (LOW, CWE-113) | component: spring-web ContentDisposition response/multipart header splitting from untrusted filename | MITIGATED. Evidence: (1) the only Content-Disposition header is EventReportController.java:122, built from ReportExportService.fileName() (ReportExportService.java:39-41) = slug(enum reportType) + "-" + UUID eventId + ".pdf|.csv" - fully server-controlled, no user-supplied filename. (2) The connector is embedded Tomcat, which the advisory states rejects malicious header characters (case 1 applies only to non-default/legacy connectors). (3) No outbound multipart bodies built with Spring's ContentDisposition/MultipartBodyBuilder (grep src/main: none); Brevo/S3 SDKs use their own clients. UploadController.java:70-83 /files/{id}/content sets no Content-Disposition. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: any Content-Disposition built from a user/stored filename (e.g. StoredFile.fileName), any outbound multipart via RestClient/WebClient, or a switch away from Tomcat.

CVE-2026-59270 (CRITICAL, ~9.4) | component: spring-security-config UnboundIdContainer (embedded LDAP server binds 0.0.0.0 with well-known admin bind DN) | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: no com.unboundid:unboundid-ldapsdk and no spring-security-ldap / spring-ldap in dependency tree (mvnw dependency:tree 2026-10-09); grep ldap|UnboundId in src/main and application*.properties (no spring.ldap.embedded.*) returns nothing. The container class ships in spring-security-config but cannot start without the UnboundID SDK. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: ANY LDAP dependency or spring.ldap.embedded.* property is added. NOTE: this service binds server.address=0.0.0.0 (application.properties:31), so an embedded LDAP server would be network-reachable - treat that change as a blocker requiring this CVE to be un-suppressed.

CVE-2026-47841 (HIGH) | component: spring-security-web WebAuthn/passkey userVerification=REQUIRED bypass after HTTP session serialization | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: all three preconditions unmet - no WebAuthn (no webauthn4j in dependency tree; grep webAuthn|passkey in src/main: none); no distributed session store (no spring-session-*); sessions disabled (SecurityConfig.java:38 SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS). Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: passkey/WebAuthn login, spring-session, or stateful sessions introduced.

CVE-2026-47842 (MEDIUM, ~6.5) | component: spring-security-crypto AesBytesEncryptor / Encryptors.standard|stronger| text|delux (null-IV AES/CBC, deterministic ciphertext) | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: grep AesBytesEncryptor|Encryptors|Encryptor|Cipher|SecretKeySpec in src/main returns nothing. Only spring-security-crypto use is BCryptPasswordEncoder (shared/config/AppConfig.java:15). JWT signing is done by jjwt. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: any field-level/app-level encryption is added (use AES-GCM with random IV via JCA or Tink, never Encryptors.* on this line).

CVE-2026-59276 (MEDIUM, ~5.9) | component: Spring Security non-constant-time comparisons in DigestAuthenticationFilter, KeyBasedPersistenceTokenService, BalloonHashing/Pbkdf2 Password4j encoders, InMemoryOAuth2AuthorizationService | NOT_APPLICABLE. Evidence: grep DigestAuthentication|KeyBasedPersistenceTokenService|Password4j|OAuth2Authorization in src/main returns nothing; no password4j or spring-security-oauth2-authorization-server in dependency tree. Password encoder is BCryptPasswordEncoder (AppConfig.java:15); auth is a custom JWT bearer filter. Reviewed 2026-10-09. Re-review: Digest auth, Password4j encoders, KeyBasedPersistenceTokenService, or an embedded authorization server added. (Own code comparing secrets, e.g. refresh/reset token hashes, should use MessageDigest.isEqual - out of scope of this CVE.)
